title: Lucky Pebble
description: adds a pebble that either gives absortion or wither. the icon of the mod is not the pebble itself, but a interigent on a crafting recepie
body: put cobbestone in stonecutter to get a pebble! combine gold nugget and 4 pebbles (crafting table recepie) to get a lucky pebble! it either gives you absortion 10 or wither. it has a small cooldown. i plan on adding more effects, but for now im gonna focus on making new mods!
